ranked.headline: Models infer single-cell state dynamics from lineage, regulatory, and perturbation data
ranked.summary: Dynamical models now pair scRNA-seq trajectories with lineage context, regulatory structure, and biological constraints rather than static snapshots.

ranked.headline: Mapping non-coding and rare variants to gene regulation across tissues and cell types
ranked.summary: Population-scale single-cell and multiomic resources now link variant effects to specific cell types, tissues and regulatory mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Single-cell foundation models reused for perturbation and multi-omic prediction
ranked.summary: Frozen single-cell foundation model representations are being reused via probes, distillation, and in-context learning for new prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Generative models capture interaction-induced conformational change in protein ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend conformational modeling from static bound geometries to unbound-to-bound transitions and experimentally weighted ensembles.

ranked.headline: Attributing gene expression to cell populations, cell states, and spatial niches
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics methods now model niche-conditioned gene co-expression and boundary-level label transitions rather than domain labels alone.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics workflows and databases unify multi-platform data for reuse
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics outputs from Visium, Xenium, MERFISH and Stereo-seq are consolidated into reproducible workflows and shared, searchable resources.

ranked.headline: Assay-aware and protocol-matched ML models for prioritizing small molecules
ranked.summary: Large pretrained bioactivity models and protocol-matched benchmarks now define how ML prioritizes small molecules for activity and ADMET.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics atlases and models link molecular profiles to clinical outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent items pair multi-layer molecular data with survival, drug sensitivity, intervention outcomes, and immune-related adverse events.

ranked.headline: Bounded agents and domain-specific software make biological workflows auditable
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers now pair bounded LLM agents and compiled or graph-based tools with provenance-tracked biological workflows.

ranked.headline: Normalization, probe design and joint testing shape spatial and single-nucleus readouts
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-nucleus methods now jointly test expression, localize domains and map neurodegeneration pathways from published and preprint datasets.

ranked.headline: Whole-genome doubling shapes tumour evolution and is detected at subclonal resolution
ranked.summary: Single-cell and clonal-fraction approaches are moving WGD analysis beyond binary tumour classification across large pan-cancer cohorts.

ranked.headline: Held-out validation design decides whether biological prediction gains survive scrutiny
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether predictive performance survives independent validation, matched controls, and held-out cohorts across omics and imaging.

ranked.headline: Mechanics and diffusion in simulations generate tissue and diatom architectures
ranked.summary: Recent work links explicit mechanical and diffusive mechanisms to emergent tissue and silica geometry, largely through model-based reproduction.

ranked.headline: LLM agents bounded by source evidence and provenance in biomedical research
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether biomedical LLM agents can be checked against source material, provenance and harness design rather than free generation.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological models conditioned for biomolecular design and prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent work makes conditioning variables, training objectives, and fusion rules explicit in DNA, RNA, antibody, and peptide models.

ranked.headline: Deep learning methods now annotate chromatin architecture from Hi-C contact matrices
ranked.summary: Compact, foundation-model-based, and interpretable architectures are being applied to single-cell and bulk Hi-C data for structural annotation.

ranked.headline: Transcript-level methods refine isoform quantification from RNA-seq data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark new isoform quantifiers and mapping filters against Kallisto, Salmon, and spike-in recovery, sharpening transcript resolution.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale data resolve organelle metabolism and sex chromosome evolution
ranked.summary: Nuclear and organellar assemblies for a nitroplast-hosting haptophyte enable direct tests of organelle-host metabolic remodeling at genome scale.

ranked.headline: Curated resources pair 3D biomolecular structures with experimental binding data
ranked.summary: Recent releases add benchmark-ready splits and affinity-anchored annotation to structure databases spanning RNA, antibodies, and venom toxins.

ranked.headline: Resources extend variant pathogenicity scoring to non-coding and mtDNA positions
ranked.summary: MitImpact 4 and MetaDome 2027 broaden variant evidence to non-coding mtDNA and homologous protein domains, beyond prior coding-sequence focus.

ranked.headline: Predicting spatial omics from histology and cross-modal data, judged by validation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether predicted spatial and single-cell omics layers are actually recovered, not just fit accurately.

ranked.headline: Learned scores prioritize protein variants, binding pockets and complex interfaces
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair calibrated uncertainty, model attribution and structure-aware scoring with mutation, pocket and interaction prioritization.

ranked.headline: Simulation and HDX-MS integration sharpen structural interpretation of protein dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair MD simulation, HDX-MS reweighting and AI structural modelling to read out protein conformational effects.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods for microbiome inference under compositionality and confounding
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and phylogeny-aware models test whether microbiome inference methods remain valid under compositional structure and confounding.

ranked.headline: Bursty production shapes timing, rhythm transmission and signaling information
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extract transmission and timing properties directly from stochastic gene-expression dynamics rather than introducing new model classes.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models infer variants and taxa directly from raw sequencing data
ranked.summary: Three new items apply deep learning to sequencing reads for somatic variant calling, microbial taxonomy, and single-cell representation learning.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models map DNA sequence to initiation, co-accessibility and motifs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply interpretable neural networks to predict initiation, co-accessibility, and promoter motif activity from DNA sequence.

ranked.headline: Pangenome structure and transposon dynamics in genome expansion and contraction
ranked.summary: Graph pangenomes and forward simulation now resolve structural variation and transposon insertion-deletion dynamics across isolate genomes.

ranked.headline: Simulations treat driven condensates as dynamic, feedback-controlled systems
ranked.summary: Recent simulations model condensate-scale organization under explicit driving and feedback rather than as static endpoints.

ranked.headline: LLM agents coupled to clinical data and genomic skills for outcome prediction and analysis
ranked.summary: Recent papers test LLM agents that invoke executable skills or trained predictors against ML models, expert classifications, and bioinformatics benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Inferring glioblastoma invasion and proliferation parameters from imaging-based models
ranked.summary: Single time-point MRI and ex vivo single-cell imaging are being paired with explicit models to recover mechanistic glioblastoma invasion quantities.

ranked.headline: Predicted structures curated into reusable resources for proteome-scale annotation
ranked.summary: Predicted structures are now being integrated with curated annotation and literature mining into standardized, reusable resources across proteomes.

ranked.headline: Curated knowledgebases expand microbial genome annotation across hosts and environments
ranked.summary: Newly published resources consolidate bacterial, annelid, and digester microbiome data with functional annotation pipelines.

ranked.headline: Jagged-end correction for cfDNA methylation profiling preserves duplex integrity
ranked.summary: Methylation-based cfDNA analysis now pairs sequencing-level error correction with expanding cell-type marker resources and genome-wide methylation compendia.

ranked.headline: Integrating plasma metabolomics with genetic association and disease evidence
ranked.summary: Large-scale metabolomics resources and GWAS methods now link metabolic measures to genetics, disease risk and medication confounding.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks for quantifying 3D and single-molecule microscopy data
ranked.summary: Four new preprints address uncertainty modeling, benchmarking, and quantification software that determine the fidelity of imaging-derived measurements.

ranked.headline: Computational methods map catalytic RNAs, communication residues, and DDX3X unwinding
ranked.summary: Genome-scale ab initio prediction and network-based residue analysis now span RNA catalysis discovery, allosteric communication mapping, and helicase mechanism.

ranked.headline: Parameter degeneracy and bursting transitions in minimal neuron and population models
ranked.summary: Minimal models now map how bifurcation sequences, bursting, and pulsed-field regimes depend on parameter choices in excitable cells.

ranked.headline: Sequence models and assemblies map regulatory elements and selection footprints
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs high-quality assemblies and deep learning models with regulatory and selection inference across species and tissues.

ranked.headline: Proteome-trained priors and benchmarks probe de novo peptide sequencing limits
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now expose shared de novo sequencing errors while priors and deep learning fragment prediction target search efficiency.
